text:
Predicates:
NetflixShow(x) ::: x is a Netflix show.
Popular(x) ::: x is popular.
BingeWatch(karen, x) ::: Karen binge-watches x.
Download(karen, x) ::: Karen downloads x.
Share(karen, x, lisa) ::: Karen shares x with Lisa.
BlackMirror ::: The show Black Mirror.
Premises:
NetflixShow(blackMirror) ::: "Black Mirror" is a Netflix show.
Popular(blackMirror) ::: "Black Mirror" is a popular Netflix show.
∀x (NetflixShow(x) ∧ Popular(x) → BingeWatch(karen, x)) ::: If a Netflix show is popular, Karen will binge-watch it.
∀x (BingeWatch(karen, x) ↔ Download(karen, x)) ::: Karen binge-watches a Netflix show iff she downloads it.
¬Download(karen, blackMirror) ::: Karen does not download "Black Mirror".
∀x (BingeWatch(karen, x) → Share(karen, x, lisa)) ::: If Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will share it with Lisa.
Conclusion:
Share(karen, blackMirror, lisa) ::: Karen will share "Black Mirror" with Lisa.
